sections.text:
**Exploring SEO trends**

I'm thinking we can provide general SEO tips, but it's possible that current recommendations are shifting, especially with trends around AI in SEO. It might be helpful to browse the latest suggestions to ensure we're up-to-date. Using web resources should help me gather that current information. I'll take the time to consider what’s trending and make sure the user gets the most relevant and effective advice possible!

“AI SEO” usually means optimizing your website to be found, understood, cited, and trusted by **AI-powered search experiences** like Google AI Overviews / AI Mode, Bing Copilot, Perplexity, ChatGPT Search-style tools, and traditional search engines.

The short version: **don’t chase “AI SEO hacks.” Build clear, useful, well-structured, authoritative content that answers real questions better than competitors.** Google’s own guidance says traditional SEO fundamentals still matter for generative AI search, and it specifically warns against gimmicks like unnecessary “AI files” or artificial formatting tricks. ([developers.google.com](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide?authuser=4&hl=en&utm_source=openai))

## 1. Start with normal SEO foundations

AI search still depends heavily on crawlable, indexable, high-quality web content.

Make sure your site has:

- **Clean indexation:** important pages are crawlable and not blocked by `robots.txt` or `noindex`.
- **XML sitemap:** submitted in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.
- **Fast, mobile-friendly pages.**
- **Clear site architecture:** important pages reachable within a few clicks.
- **Descriptive title tags and meta descriptions.**
- **Canonical tags** where needed.
- **No thin, duplicate, or doorway pages.**

Bing’s webmaster guidance says SEO best practices that support discovery, indexing accuracy, and content clarity also support eligibility for AI-generated experiences and citations. ([bing.com](https://www.bing.com/webmasters/help/webmaster-guidelines-30fba23a?afsrc=1&utm_source=openai))

## 2. Create “answer-first” pages

AI systems often pull from pages that directly answer specific questions. So structure your content around the questions your customers actually ask.

For each important service, product, or topic page, include:

- A direct answer near the top.
- Clear headings using natural language.
- Definitions, examples, comparisons, pricing guidance, pros/cons, steps, FAQs.
- Specific details, not vague marketing copy.
- Original insights from your business experience.

Example structure:

```text
H1: Commercial Roof Repair in Austin

Intro: Directly explain who the service is for and what problem you solve.

H2: What does commercial roof repair include?
H2: Common signs your roof needs repair
H2: How much does commercial roof repair cost in Austin?
H2: Repair vs. replacement
H2: Our process
H2: FAQs
H2: Contact / quote CTA
```

This helps both traditional search engines and AI answer engines understand what your page is about.

## 3. Demonstrate real expertise and trust

Google emphasizes “helpful, reliable, people-first content,” not content made just to manipulate rankings. ([developers.google.com](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/creating-helpful-content?utm_source=openai))

Add trust signals such as:

- Author names and credentials.
- Real business address and contact info.
- Case studies.
- Original photos.
- Customer reviews.
- Certifications, licenses, awards, memberships.
- Dates showing when content was reviewed or updated.
- Clear refund, warranty, privacy, and shipping policies if relevant.

For local businesses, make sure your **Google Business Profile**, Bing Places profile, Apple Maps listing, Yelp, industry directories, and local citations are consistent.

## 4. Use schema markup

Structured data helps search engines understand your content. It is not a magic ranking factor, but it can improve clarity.

Useful schema types include:

- `Organization`
- `LocalBusiness`
- `Product`
- `Service`
- `FAQPage`
- `HowTo`
- `Review`
- `Article`
- `BreadcrumbList`
- `VideoObject`

For example, a local service business might use:

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "Example Plumbing Co.",
  "areaServed": "Denver, CO",
  "telephone": "+1-555-123-4567",
  "url": "https://www.example.com",
  "sameAs": [
    "https://www.facebook.com/example",
    "https://www.linkedin.com/company/example"
  ]
}
```

Validate your schema before publishing.

## 5. Build topical authority

Instead of publishing random blog posts, build clusters around your core money topics.

Example for a law firm:

**Main page:**  
“Personal Injury Lawyer in Phoenix”

**Supporting pages:**

- “What to do after a car accident in Phoenix”
- “How much is a personal injury case worth in Arizona?”
- “Arizona statute of limitations for personal injury claims”
- “Car accident settlement process”
- “Slip and fall injury claims”
- “Motorcycle accident claims”
- “Truck accident claims”

Then internally link these pages together.

AI search tools are more likely to recognize your site as a strong source when you cover a topic deeply and consistently.

## 6. Optimize for conversational queries

AI search queries tend to be longer and more specific.

Instead of only targeting:

> “best CRM software”

Also target:

> “What is the best CRM for a 10-person B2B sales team?”  
> “How much should a small business pay for CRM software?”  
> “HubSpot vs Salesforce for startups”  
> “Do I need a CRM if I already use spreadsheets?”

Add FAQ sections, comparison pages, buyer guides, and use-case pages.

## 7. Make your content easy to quote or cite

AI systems often summarize from concise, factual passages.

Use:

- Short explanatory paragraphs.
- Tables.
- Bullet lists.
- Step-by-step instructions.
- Definitions.
- Clear claims backed by evidence.
- Original data when possible.

Example:

```text
The average commercial roof inspection takes 60–120 minutes, depending on the size, roof type, and number of access points. After the inspection, the contractor should provide photos, a written condition report, and repair recommendations.
```

That is more useful than:

```text
Our team provides best-in-class roof inspection services with unmatched excellence and customer satisfaction.
```

## 8. Avoid mass-producing low-quality AI content

Using AI to help write content is not automatically bad. Google has said AI-generated content can be acceptable if it is helpful, reliable, and created for people rather than to manipulate rankings. ([developers.google.com](https://developers.google.com/search/blog/2023/02/google-search-and-ai-content?hl=en&utm_source=openai))

Bad AI SEO:

- Publishing hundreds of generic posts.
- Rewriting competitors’ content.
- Creating fake expertise.
- Making pages with no original value.
- Stuffing keywords unnaturally.
- Using hallucinated facts or fake citations.

Good AI-assisted SEO:

- Drafting outlines.
- Expanding FAQs based on real customer questions.
- Summarizing expert interviews.
- Creating first drafts that a human expert edits.
- Turning internal knowledge into useful public content.

## 9. Get mentioned on authoritative websites

AI systems don’t only look at your website. They also learn from the broader web.

Work on earning mentions from:

- Industry publications.
- Local news.
- Podcasts.
- Directories.
- Review platforms.
- Partner websites.
- Professional associations.
- Comparison sites.
- Forums and communities where your audience asks questions.

For AI visibility, brand mentions and third-party validation are becoming more important.

## 10. Track AI search visibility

Use the usual tools:

- Google Search Console.
- Bing Webmaster Tools.
- GA4.
- Rank tracking tools.
- Server logs.
- Brand mention tracking.
- Referral traffic from AI search tools.

Bing has an **AI Performance Report** in Bing Webmaster Tools that shows how your site appears in Microsoft Copilot, Bing AI-generated summaries, and partner AI experiences. ([bing.com](https://www.bing.com/webmasters/help/ai-performance-9f8e7d6c?utm_source=openai))

Also manually test prompts like:

- “Best [service] near me”
- “Who offers [service] in [city]?”
- “Compare [your brand] vs [competitor]”
- “What companies provide [solution] for [industry]?”
- “How do I solve [problem your product solves]?”

See whether your brand appears, whether competitors appear, and what sources are cited.

## 11. Create content for different buying stages

AI search often answers broad informational queries before users are ready to buy. Cover the full funnel.

### Awareness

- “What is…?”
- “How does… work?”
- “Why does… happen?”

### Consideration

- “Best tools for…”
- “X vs Y”
- “How much does… cost?”
- “Questions to ask before hiring…”

### Decision

- Product pages.
- Service pages.
- Case studies.
- Testimonials.
- Pricing pages.
- Demo/consultation pages.

## 12. Add original information competitors don’t have

This is one of the biggest AI SEO advantages.

Examples:

- Original research.
- Internal data.
- Expert commentary.
- Case studies.
- Customer stories.
- Before/after photos.
- Templates.
- Calculators.
- Industry benchmarks.
- Practical checklists.

AI systems are more likely to surface content that adds something unique rather than generic rewritten information.

## 13. Keep important pages updated

For topics where facts change — pricing, laws, tools, product specs, local regulations, statistics — update regularly.

Add:

```text
Last updated: August 2026
Reviewed by: [Expert Name]
```

But only do this if the page was actually reviewed.
